title: IBM CEO says open weight models are now good and cheap on-prem
hook_text: Open AI models cost a fraction now.
script:
Open weight models cost ten to twenty five percent of frontier models to run.
IBM chief executive officer Arvind Krishna notes these systems are now irresistibly good on premises.
Running these local systems avoids heavy cloud provider fees for enterprise clients.
Companies keep complete data privacy by hosting software directly on their own private servers.
This major shift challenges centralized cloud monopolies dominating enterprise infrastructure today.
Would your company migrate AI workloads to local servers?
